title: Reentrancy Risk in Callback Functions via State-After-External-Call Pattern
impact: Malicious contracts invoking callbacks (`onMorphoSupply`, `onMorphoRepay`, `onMorphoLiquidate`) can re-enter Morpho functions while internal accounting updates (or token transfers) occur after or around the callback execution, potentially violating accounting invariants or manipulating utilization states across cross-market read-only calls.
